name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the preceding context, maintaining the flow of conversation and ensuring the continuation is appropriate to the topic at hand.

name: Informative Value
description: Assesses the extent to which the response provides new, interesting, or useful information that enhances the conversation.

name: Engagement Potential
description: Evaluates how likely the response is to encourage further conversation or interaction, prompting the other participant to continue the dialogue.

name: Coherence
description: Determines the logical structure and clarity of the response, ensuring it makes sense and follows a clear line of thought.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the originality and inventiveness of the response, capturing the ability to present ideas in a novel or imaginative way.
